key_findings: Review: potential acute mechanisms of COVID-19 neurological disease include coagulopathy with hypoxic-ischaemic injury, blood-brain barrier abnormalities with endotheliopathy, and possible neuroinvasion with neuro-immune responses.
Encephalitis-like COVID-19 presentations show elevated CSF IL-6, IL-18, TNF-α and CXCL10, but viral RNA is usually not detectable in CSF, favouring immune-mediated mechanisms.
